race.description: Courtney Keeffe Elders Real Estate Mdn
race.comment: NORTHERN DIAMOND (3) brings the strongest exposed profile, resuming after a long break with three placings from four starts and a solid Saturday-company second at Ascot behind Tactics to close her last campaign. The easier company helps and she can return with a bang. BONDEX (5) has race fitness and a genuine platform after a Bunbury fifth behind Beyond Measure, having gone within a neck two back on soft ground despite being slow away. Ticks a few boxes here despite the wide alley and can put his best foot forward. MISS AJAX (11) has the most recent near-miss, finishing second to Beyond Measure at Bunbury after covering ground, and she has already beaten BONDEX in that line. That looks a strong form reference for this. PERFECT SCORE (6) resumes for a new stable after a debut second at Bunbury as odds-on favourite, with a close recent trial giving enough confidence that she can run well fresh. OPEN THROTTLE (1) can go one better.
